ValidationRule.description: Requires Requested ABC Segment Change and Justification fields to be completed when ABC Segment Verification is set to Needs to Change. Prevents incomplete change requests from being submitted for approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( ABC_Segment_Verification__c , "Needs to Change"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Requested_ABC_Segment__c , "" ), LEN( ABC_Segment_Change_Justification__c ) = 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When ABC Segment Verification is set to Needs to Change, both Requested ABC Segment and ABC Segment Justification are required.
